import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public class JotyandChocolate {

	public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
		PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
		String[] in = br.readLine().split(" ");
		long n = Long.parseLong(in[0]);
		long a = Long.parseLong(in[1]);
		long b = Long.parseLong(in[2]);
		long p = Long .parseLong(in[3]);
		long q  = Long.parseLong(in[4]);
		if(p<q){
			long lcm = a*b/gcd(a,b);
		    out.println((n/a-n/lcm)*p + (n/b)*q);
		}
		else{
			long lcm = a*b/gcd(a,b);
			out.println((n/a)*p + (n/b-n/lcm)*q);
		}
		out.flush();
		out.close();
	}
	
	
	private static long gcd(long a, long b){
		if(b==0)return a;
		else
			return gcd(b,a%b);
				
	}

}
